findings.title: Exact page-size counts show a phantom page
findings.body: `Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1` counts an extra page whenever the member count is an exact multiple of the page size. For example, with 50 members and a limit of 50, the UI reports 2 pages; Next then requests offset 50 and displays an empty page. Compute the page count with ceiling division so pagination ends on the actual last page.
